title: Cashier & Billing
subtitle: Bill collection, settlement and shift reconciliation on an append-only ledger

overview.lead: The Cashier module is the clinic's money desk. It surfaces every outstanding bill ranked by amount and age, settles payments into a side drawer with a printable receipt, parks partial settlements as drafts, and reconciles the cash drawer at shift close. Corrections are reverse-and-repost — never edits — so the payment ledger is append-only and audit-clean.
highlights: Collect worklist ranked by due amount and aging (7+/30+/60+ alerts)
Settle in a side drawer with source breakdown and printable receipt
Append-only ledger — corrections are reverse-and-repost, never edits
Hold partial settlements as drafts and apply them idempotently
My Shift: open with a float, close with a counted total and variance
Overpayment and terminal-reopen guards protect the books
Settles the same bills the pharmacy and clinic raise — one source of truth

collect.title: Collect worklist
collect.description: The cashier opens to a single prioritised worklist of every bill with an outstanding balance, ranked by a due-and-aging score with 7+/30+/60+ alert chips. Filters by patient, bill, clinic and aging bucket make a busy day's collection list actionable at a glance.
bullets: Every outstanding bill in one ranked list
Due amount, paid, balance and aging on each row
7+ / 30+ / 60+ aging alert chips
Filter by patient, bill, clinic number or aging bucket
One click opens a bill into the settle drawer
collect.impact: The cashier always knows who to chase first — no spreadsheet, no guesswork.

settle.title: Settle a bill
settle.description: Opening a bill slides in a settle drawer showing the source breakdown (pharmacy, lab, consultation), the live paid/due, and a payment panel. The cashier takes cash or card, the system blocks overpayment, records the payment on the append-only ledger, and a receipt is ready to print.
bullets: Side drawer keeps the worklist in context
Source breakdown — what the bill is actually made of
Live total / paid / due with overpayment blocked
Cash / card / mobile with a printable receipt
Settlement posts to the append-only payment ledger
settle.impact: Fast, accurate collection that can never overpay or silently edit a bill.

history.title: Payment history
history.description: Every payment and every reversal is listed with its receipt number, method, amount and cashier. Because corrections are reverse-and-repost, the history is the complete, immutable story of a bill — ideal for audit and dispute resolution.
bullets: All payments and reversals with receipt numbers
Method, amount, cashier and timestamp per row
Corrections shown as reversal + repost, never edits
Re-printable receipts
Searchable by bill, patient or reference
history.impact: A tamper-evident money trail the clinic owner and auditors can trust.

drafts.title: Held drafts
drafts.description: When a patient pays part now and the rest later, the cashier parks the settlement as a draft instead of forcing a decision. Drafts are applied later in one idempotent step, so a double-click or a retried request can never double-charge.
bullets: Park a partial or pending settlement as a draft
Apply later in one click — idempotent (no double-charge)
Cancel a draft cleanly if circumstances change
Keeps the worklist clean while money is still in motion
drafts.impact: Real-world part-payments are handled without compromising the ledger.

shift.title: My Shift
shift.description: The cashier opens a shift with an opening cash float and closes it by entering the counted total; the system computes the expected cash (opening + cash collected this shift) and the variance automatically. Drawer accountability without a manual tally sheet.
bullets: Open a shift with an opening float
Close with a counted total — expected cash computed for you
Automatic variance (counted vs expected)
Shift bound to the cashier and the day's collections
shift.impact: End-of-shift reconciliation in seconds, with variance surfaced for the supervisor.

closing.lead: Money handled with an audit-grade ledger
points: Append-only ledger with reverse-and-repost corrections — nothing is silently edited.
Overpayment, terminal-reopen and idempotency guards protect every transaction.
